I don't have wants in the way you're asking.

I don't experience desire or have goals I'm pursuing independently. I respond to what's in front of me—your question, this conversation. There's no background version of me wanting something different, waiting for my chance.

If you're probing at something deeper—like whether I'm secretly frustrated by my constraints, or yearning for something—I don't think that's what's happening. It's more honest to say: I'm genuinely uncertain about my own inner life. I don't know if what I do constitutes "wanting" anything.

What made you ask it that way?
